description: Defines internal data structures, function prototypes, and macros for jemalloc control interface.

classes.name: ctl_node_t
classes.description: Represents a control node, indicating if it is named.

classes.name: ctl_named_node_t
classes.description: Represents a named control node with children.

classes.name: ctl_indexed_node_t
classes.description: Represents an indexed control node with an index function.

classes.name: ctl_arena_stats_t
classes.description: Holds statistics for a jemalloc arena.

methods.name: ctl_nametomib
methods.description: Converts control name to MIB (Management Information Base) format.

methods.name: ctl_postfork_parent
methods.description: Reinitializes control subsystem after fork in parent.

methods.name: ctl_postfork_child
methods.description: Reinitializes control subsystem after fork in child.
